```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Sufficient, safe and nutritious food is a basic right.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Large swaths of the American population lack sufficient or nutritious food today, as in FDR’s day.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recent gains in food provision have been reversed by the current recession, forcing a choice between food and medicine or utilities in many cases.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Demand at food banks is up, and these providers have a hard time keeping sufficient food on hand.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"One in eight Americans is using food stamps, including many formerly middle-class families, even with working family members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Parents frequently go without a meal to ensure that their children can eat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The phenomenon of not knowing whether you will have food is referred to as food insecurity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The food that is available often lacks nutritional value.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Corn sweetener and soy-product-based foods produced by agribusiness create highly processed, possibly genetically modified pseudo-varieties of questionable nutrition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Locally farmed and varied products sometimes satisfy nutritional needs as well as environmental desires for shorter supply routes and less pollution within wealthier and more stable neighborhoods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Locally farmed and varied products are rarely available in poorer neighborhoods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Poorer neighborhoods often have to rely on more limited supplies of less healthy foods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
